recognize_zh: 高倍下成片大型淋巴樣細胞，核為小淋巴球核的兩倍以上、呈泡狀染色質且核膜不規則，多數可見核仁與核分裂，細胞間黏著性差，旁有一條小血管，為大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤的細胞學表現。
features: Diffuse sheets of large, discohesive lymphoid cells with nuclei ≥2 times a small lymphocyte
Vesicular to coarsely granular chromatin with irregular, folded or cleaved nuclear contours
Prominent single central or multiple peripheral nucleoli (immunoblastic and centroblastic features)
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; small capillary with red cells at the bottom
describe_en: High-power H&E shows a diffuse infiltrate of large, discohesive lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours, prominent nucleoli and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified. A small capillary is present, but angiocentric growth and adjacent brain parenchyma are not visible in this field. In the context of a CNS mass, findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS; confirmation requires B-cell immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive with nesting and more abundant cytoplasm, and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Small-cell GBM is GFAP/OLIG2 positive with fibrillary background and EGFR amplification rather than CD20 positivity.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has more eccentric nuclei and plasmacytoid cytoplasm, is CD20-negative/CD138-positive and often EBER-positive.
ALCL shows hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei and uniform strong CD30 with T-cell markers.
